Events.title: Events
Events.deleteConfirm: Delete this event? This cannot be undone.
Events.notFound: That event doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.
Events.fieldTimeZoneHint: Where the event happens — a London concert shows as London time.
Events.fieldEventUrl: Link with info about the event
Events.signInToRespond: Sign in as a member to respond.
Events.fieldEventUrlHint: Official page, tickets or event details.
Events.visibilityPublicExplanation: A public event hosted by someone else. Visible to guests who aren't signed in.
Events.visibilityMembersExplanation: Closed event, by us for us. Only Poli members can see it.
Events.visibilityMembersAndFriendsExplanation: Events where we bring friends and family — ski trips, birthdays and the like. Still only members see it in the app.
Events.fieldRemindersAtLimit: Two selected — untick one to change.
Events.fieldKind: Is this a suggestion or a confirmed event?
Events.kindSuggestionExplanation: A vibe check. Testing whether people are interested — the date can be voted on.
Events.kindConfirmedExplanation: This is happening. Put it in your calendar.
Events.fieldDatePollHint: Add dates so members can vote for the ones they can make.
Events.datePollHint: Vote for every date you can make. You can pick several.
Events.datePollClosed: Voting is closed — every date has passed.
Events.datePollVotes: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has voted} one {# can make it} other {# can make it}}
Events.advancedHint: Rarely needed — skip it if you're unsure.
Events.publishSummary: The event is only saved when you click here. Nothing goes to Discord before that.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.controllerBody: {associationName} is the data controller for the information on this site. If you have questions, contact us at {contactEmail}.
dataItems: Name, email address and profile picture from your Google account when you sign in.
Nickname, title, fun title, bio and birthday — if you fill them in.
Which events you have signed up for and attended.
Privacy.dataNote: If you sign in with Google without being a member, we store nothing about you in our database.
Privacy.whyBody: To run the association: show who the members are, plan events and keep track of who is coming. The legal basis is the membership itself and the association's legitimate interest in organising its activities.
Privacy.whoBody: Only signed-in members. The information is not public, is not shared outside the association, is never sold, and is not used for marketing.
Privacy.whereBody: In a database hosted by Supabase on servers in Stockholm, within the EU. The site itself runs on Vercel.
Privacy.retentionBody: For as long as you are a member. If you leave, we may keep your name and event history as part of the association's record — but you can always ask for everything to be deleted.
rightsItems: Find out what information we hold about you.
Complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY) if you think we are getting it wrong.
Privacy.cookiesBody: We use exactly one necessary cookie, to keep you signed in. No analytics, no tracking, no advertising.
Privacy.contactBody: Write to {contactEmail} and we will help you.
